content.title: Zodiac Signs & Their Coordinating Outfits
content.text: What To Buy This Summer, According to Your Star Sign Fashion is often regarded as a tool for self-expression, but finding what works best can be a challenge. Our styling secret: Look to your astrological sign for inspiration. Who doesn’t love reading their daily horoscope or finding which signs they are compatible with (or not)? Not only does your astrological sign offer insight into your emotional needs, but it can also help you with your wardrobe needs as well (wink, wink). The signs grouped together hold unique characteristics that can be helpful in figuring out your fashion sense and what to try. We’ve taken the guesswork out of finding your next summer look to give you the perfect zodiac signs outfits to consider. BY STACI SOSLOWITZ FOR THE FIRE SIGNS Aries, Leo, Sagittarius This grouping is described as fierce and confident with an adventurous spirit. They tend to bring high energy levels to everything they do and are unafraid to express themselves. With a bold personality and a desire to be the center of attention, it only makes sense for these individuals to lean into clothes that match their astrological signs. Fire signs embrace statement pieces and dramatic silhouettes that would look great in a bright color, especially a fiery red hue. A bouclé knit maxi dress from Proenza Schouler will surely be an eye-catching look for any fiery Leo, Sagittarius or Aries this summer. The over-the-top details of dresses like these encompass the wow factor that a fire sign needs in a statement piece. Taking it a step further, pair this daring design with coordinating red statement accessories—or choose more pared-down pieces and let the dress shine on its own. Shop Fire Signs Proenza Schouler, The Attico, BVLGARI, Stella McCartney Shop for These Zodiac Signs FOR THE EARTH SIGNS Capricorn, Taurus, Virgo Goal-oriented earth signs lean toward a more grounded approach to life and, of course, their zodiac style. They tend to appreciate stability and routines, resulting in a wardrobe full of true staple pieces for the best neutral outfits. This summer, the earth-sign trio will want to lean toward the versatile (and highly coveted) mini-skirt-and-blazer combo. This classic style gives the signs the ability to transition their outfit from office meetings to happy hours instantly, which they will appreciate. Similarly, an earth sign would love a subtle pop of color with a subdued yellow tee and matching bag to complete an ultra-chic street style look. As for their personal style, they very much march to the beat of their own drum. They prefer variety, and therefore may experiment with different bold prints, textures and vibrant colors in their wardrobe. Taking this into consideration, layering a multicolor dress under a moto jacket is just one zodiac outfit for air signs to try this summer. A breezy silhouette combined with a structured, oversized jacket brings an unexpected and cool vibe that an air sign would love. Styling with simple accessories allows for the pieces in the look to truly shine. They seek emotional fulfillment through artistic or creative means. Highly intuitive and nurturing, the water signs easily empathize with others, however, they often need time alone to reset their own energy. The best way for a water zodiac sign to recharge this summer is an outdoor weekend agenda. As water signs prioritize their wellbeing, they’ll seek a low-key, relaxing activity like sipping spritzes with friends on a patio. A mesh midi is the ideal off-duty look for water signs, no matter what their plan is.
